purpose: Executable method demonstration using selected subsets; not numerical reproduction of manuscript tables or figures
selection: Rotation unchanged: 14 middle frames. Static: 26 uniformly index-spaced frames from April 25, chosen after fully reported exploratory comparisons.

rotation.timestamp_source: Original source-file modification times interpreted as UTC by supplied source; copied-file modification times are not read at runtime.
rotation.reference_source: Matched INS headings from original filename-counter/time-anchor convention; adjacent position differences
rotation.selection_rule: middle frame (index 2) of each consecutive 5-frame group
rotation.command_schedule_source: Author confirmation: 14 positions including 0 and 360 degrees, 13 equal intervals; independent per-step encoder records not supplied.
rotation.manuscript_relation: Active calibration input of the paper-project source; selected 14-frame subset does not reproduce the historical full-data analysis.

static.selection_rule: round(linspace(0, original_count-1, 26)), includes both temporal endpoints; fixed before fit
static.timestamp_source: Original file-modification timestamp convention, saved explicitly; not a separately verified camera clock
static.reference_source: Matched INS headings from original filename-counter/time-anchor convention; differences relative to a fixed reference frame
static.relation_to_manuscript: Source sequence associated with historical static calibration; this 26-frame subset is an additional demonstration, not exact historical reproduction

selection_history: Historical uncompensated comparisons covered static 14/36/72 densities and four rotation sequences; those numbers are not current compensated results. After restoration, covariance weighting was tested on the unchanged April 19 rotation/static examples. Rotation improved; static failed. A finite three-source compensated static comparison with fixed sampling selected the April 25 26-frame subset. All outcomes retained. Exploratory selection, not blind validation.

aop_compensation.algorithm: Original first-order AoP correction selected within each candidate-centered ROI
aop_compensation.coefficient_source: Original research scripts; empirical values inferred from historical heading-error curves
aop_compensation.notes_filename: fast3dof定向与误差振荡机理说明.md

method_update.rotation: Original equal-weight adjacent-residual objective, measured INS increments instead of nominal commanded steps; covariance weighting remains optional.
method_update.static: Original equal-weight reference objective, previous 26-frame subset retained; 08:30--09:30 candidate not adopted after transfer degradation.
method_update.evaluation: No -0.19 degree fixed-bias subtraction in either method
method_update.target: 40% heading RMSE reduction in each selected example; rotation adjacent residual halving not achieved
method_update.focal: Explicit soft stabilization around author-reported camera-supplied initial1300 px; engineering weight0.02degree², scale130px; original equal objective retained as no-focal control.
method_update.reference: Both modes use matched INS; no exact mechanical-angle or independent calibration-set validation claim.
